head_commit.message:
Skip PRs that touch no submissions/ path in the proof scheduler

Statement PRs under challenges/ and auto-research PRs failed the proof
layout check, so the publisher closed them. The scheduler now ignores a
PR whose complete file list has no submissions/ path (filename or
rename source); maintainers review it by hand. Mixed, renamed and
oversized PRs still go through the layout check.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
